articles.title: The Mill Hill Lions Club Announces New Hours for Summer
articles.deck: Residents of Stonebridge filled the hall on Wednesday to ask questions about the plan.
body: Public works estimates the work will take about 11 weeks once it begins.

articles.title: Letter: Thanks to the Cedar Hollow Garden Club
body: To the editor: I have lived on Juniper Street for 15 years, and I want to say what a difference the Cedar Hollow Garden Club has made.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Please keep the summer concert series in the budget. Many of us on Juniper Street use it every week. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the August meeting.
Lorraine Haddad, Kettle Hill

articles.deck: The vote came after 40 residents spoke at Thursday’s session.
body: The ordinance will return to the agenda at the next regular session, unless the chair calls a special meeting first. Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days.

articles.title: Mildred Radke, 88, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Mildred Radke for the many years of service to Upper Commons.
body: Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Millrace Library branch in his or her name. Born in Upper Commons in the years after the war, Mildred Radke spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Mildred Radke died in July at home on Reed Place, at the age of 88.
